verdict.rationale: Cursor documents routing model access through cloud platforms, namely AWS Bedrock via access keys or IAM roles, and Azure OpenAI, configured in the dashboard. This is limited: custom keys only work with chat models (Tab stays on Cursor's models), and Zero Data Retention does not apply when using your own keys. Enterprise service accounts give non-human credentials for automation, but none of this is user sign-in through an enterprise identity provider. Missing for 10: any SSO/SAML/OIDC enterprise identity-provider login evidence, cloud-platform auth covering all features (Tab), Google Vertex or similar coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability

citations.quote: plus Azure OpenAI and AWS Bedrock (access keys or IAM roles via the dashboard)
Custom API keys only work with chat models. Tab completion continues using Cursor's built-in models
non-human accounts that enable teams to securely automate Cursor-powered workflows at scale
